name: Sneak Thief
desc:
💰 Welcome to Sneak Thief!
You are a home burglar who finds the art of stealing priceless artifacts appealing. Work your way down the list of robberies to truly put your criminal skills to the test. Sneakily disable alarms, traps, and fight off guards to successfully rob a home or complete a heist. 

👍Like the game? Give it a Thumbs Up! 👍
Please be mindful that the game may have issues or bugs. Make sure to report issues to the Vicious Creations community server!

📌Early Access/Beta Version 5.0
Beta is available to all platforms. Legacy is not.
For a more visually appealing experience, please set graphics to 5 or above.

Recreation as a passion project of the Steam game: Sneak Thief.
